BankTransaction.description: A transcribed bank entry, not a claim of complete statement coverage.

booking_date.description: Date the bank records the transaction in the statement, as YYYY-MM-DD.
booking_date.title: Booking date

value_date.description: Printed transaction value date; null when not stated separately.
value_date.title: Value date

amount.description: Signed amount: positive is credit and negative is debit from the account holder's perspective.
amount.title: Transaction amount

description.description: Transaction narrative exactly as printed; null when absent.
description.title: Transaction description

counterparty_name.description: Named payer or payee explicitly identified by the statement; null when absent.
counterparty_name.title: Counterparty name

BankTransaction.title: BankTransaction

start_date.description: First calendar date included in the reporting or payment period, as YYYY-MM-DD.
start_date.title: Start date

end_date.description: Last calendar date included in the period, as YYYY-MM-DD; must not precede the start date.
end_date.title: End date

Money.description: Exact monetary value; JSON serializes the amount as a decimal string.

amount.description: Monetary amount in the associated currency, preserving source precision and sign.
amount.title: Amount

currency.description: ISO three-letter currency code for the monetary amount.
currency.title: Currency

Money.title: Money

PostalAddress.description: An address as printed; policy decides which local components are necessary.

address_line_1.description: Primary street, building, or locality line exactly as stated by the source.
address_line_1.title: Address line 1

address_line_2.description: Additional unit, floor, building, or locality information; null when absent.
address_line_2.title: Address line 2

city.description: City or locality named in the address; null when absent.
city.title: City

region.description: State, province, or administrative region named in the address; null when absent.
region.title: Region

postal_code.description: Postal code as printed, preserving letters, spaces, and leading zeros; null when absent.
postal_code.title: Postal code

country_code.description: ISO two-letter country code established by the source or verified reference; null when unknown.
country_code.title: Country code

PostalAddress.title: PostalAddress

canonical_schema.description: Structured facts from a bank statement.

document_type.description: Identifies this payload as bank statement.
document_type.title: Document type

account_holders.description: One or more account-holder names exactly as printed, including joint holders.
account_holders.title: Account holders

account_identifier.description: Printed account number or IBAN; retain masking and leading zeros.
account_identifier.title: Account identifier

holder_address.description: Account-holder address printed on the statement.
holder_address.title: Holder address

statement_period.description: Inclusive reporting period covered by the statement.
statement_period.title: Statement period

issue_date.description: Statement issue date, if separately stated from the period end.
issue_date.title: Issue date

currency.description: ISO three-letter currency of the statement account.
currency.title: Currency

opening_balance.description: Account balance at the beginning of the stated reporting period.
opening_balance.title: Opening balance

closing_balance.description: Account balance at the end of the stated reporting period.
closing_balance.title: Closing balance

transactions.description: Transcribed transactions; null means not extracted, while an empty list requires evidence of no transactions.
